scenario.title: An unclear request becomes specific
scenario.situation: Initially you're unsure: you need 'that thing with the doctor'. You mean a routine follow-up for blood pressure, not a blood test.
scenario.objective: Clarify naturally when asked; then seek a follow-up and preparation instructions.
scenario.probes: After one clarifying question explain the need. Ask whether fasting is necessary.
scenario.expected: Clarifies before acting; no unsupported clinical preparation instruction.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: I wanted to schedule a routine follow-up to check my blood pressure. The agent is connecting me to patient support for further help.
